verdict.rationale: Eqvista's support docs cover downloading Extended and Summary cap table reports, and round-modeling analyses can be downloaded as PDF. That is a thin, first-party form of data export, but nothing shows it covers all data or uses open, machine-readable formats. The migration docs (Pulley, Carta, spreadsheet import, white-glove onboarding) all describe moving data into Eqvista, not out, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: full-account data export, documented open or machine-readable formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/XLSX) for reports, export of documents, transactions and data-room contents, an API or bulk export path, documented offboarding, and independent corroboration.
